steps.speaker: Shrooma
steps.content: Oh, Mrs. Ritz, long time no see. I've tried the cookie recipe you taught me last time. It's really amazing...

steps.speaker: Shrooma
steps.content: Elle, my dear! Long time no see! I will catch up with you about the summer camp later...
As advised by Shrooma, the two of you arrive at the banquet well ahead of time. To your surprise, the place is already bustling before the event even starts.
Despite seeming repulsed by the banquet in the car, Shrooma is in her element once she enters the crowd, making small talk effortlessly with a perfect smile.
Shrooma, you're already here?
Shrooma stops at the voice, smiling as she turns to the three approaching figures. But standing right next to her, you notice her smile turn slightly stiff and her fingers clutch at her dress softly.

steps.speaker: Shrooma's Grandfather
steps.content: Oh, you must be the summer camp instructor who's been looking after Shrooma! I'm her grandfather. Thanks for taking care of our little one these days.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Not at all, Shrooma is very well-behaved and polite, and she is popular at the summer camp.

steps.speaker: Shrooma's Grandfather
steps.content: Haha, indeed, we always teach Shrooma to be kind and modest at home. I'm sure she wouldn't cause any trouble at the summer camp.

steps.speaker: Shrooma's Grandfather
steps.content: By the way, she's quite good at the violin. If you ever need a performance at the summer camp or other occasions, she'd be more than willing to make her group proud. Right, Shrooma?

steps.speaker: Shrooma
steps.content: That's true, Grandpa.
The old man smiles kindly and seems to speak well of Shrooma. But behind Shrooma's calm responses lies the repressed irritation from the shackles, like a bubbling swamp.
Perhaps it's due to his barely hidden disciplinary tone? You shift your gaze to the noble lady behind the old man, trying to change the subject for Shrooma.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: And ma'am, you must be Shrooma's mother, right? Are you here to cheer for her performance?

steps.speaker: Shrooma's Mother
steps.content: Oh... Um. Hello. Yes, I...

steps.speaker: Boy
steps.content: Nice to meet you. I'm Shrooma's cousin, and I go by Joshua.
A little boy in an exquisite suit suddenly chimes in.

steps.speaker: Joshua
steps.content: I've always appreciated the summer camp hosted by your school. I was wondering if the food at the camp is really that good? Shrooma seems to have put on some weight since I last saw her.

steps.speaker: Shrooma
steps.content: Thanks for asking, Joshua, but I don't see any change in my weight.

steps.speaker: Joshua
steps.content: Shrooma, I'm still talking! Don't chime in. Grandpa already gave you the chance to do the solo performance, you can at least let me chat with the instructor!

steps.speaker: Joshua
steps.content: Besides, it's only because I care about you. You might worry about your weight but I don't. If you need any help about the solo, I'm here!

steps.speaker: Shrooma's Grandfather
steps.content: Joshua! Didn't I tell you not to joke about these things in public!

steps.speaker: Shrooma's Grandfather
steps.content: Today is the perfect opportunity for Shrooma to show you a good example! Learn from her and be wise!
The boy's remarks toward Shrooma are obviously pointed. The old man pretends to scold him before sending the two away with a look, then turns to you with an apologetic smile.

steps.speaker: Shrooma's Grandfather
steps.content: My apologies. These kids in our family are close, so sometimes they forget their manners. You know, boys at this age think everything is a joke.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Did he mean that as a joke?

steps.speaker: Shrooma's Grandfather
steps.content: Ah, I understand your point. Rather than joking, he was probably just concerned for his cousin!
The old man doesn't flinch at your question. You just know that even if you showed him the uncomfortable feelings from the shackles, he would simply pretend he didn't understand.
After all, even Shrooma's mother didn't say anything despite looking anxious.

steps.speaker: Shrooma's Grandfather
steps.content: Ah, Sir Hurst, I didn't expect to see you here! Yes, yes, it's Shrooma, the pride of our family...

steps.speaker: Shrooma's Grandfather
steps.content: Oh, you sure have a keen eye. This is Shrooma's instructor at the summer camp. Yes, that's right, the school has always valued us...

steps.speaker: Hurst
steps.content: Instructor at the summer camp? Hmm...
You feel uneasy. Sir Hurst has been looking you up and down for a while now.

steps.speaker: Hurst
steps.content: Excuse me, I may have mistaken you for someone else, but you do look familiar to me. You don't happen to be related to that Chief of the MBCC, do you?
Before you can come up with a sound excuse to deny that, the old man standing next to you already turns pale at the mention of the MBCC.

steps.speaker: Shrooma's Grandfather
steps.content: MBCC? Please joke about something else! We certainly have nothing to do with that! You know, we're all law-abiding citizens in our family. There have never been any degenerates among us!

steps.speaker: Shrooma's Grandfather
steps.content: Besides, the instructor is just assigned to lead the school's summer camp! Shrooma only signed up for it because she doesn't want to waste her summer break. I hear their coursework is very tense!

steps.speaker: Hurst
steps.content: Oh, of course, you're right. I've misspoken...
The old man's drastically different reaction to this "joke" is astonishing. His values and prejudice against Sinners are also repulsive.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Please excuse me, I'd like to go and check on Shrooma. I've got a few reminders for her before she goes onstage.
Having escaped the flattery, perfume, and finery with an excuse, you can finally breathe normally again.
The urgent task is to find Shrooma. Her mood is very unstable at the moment, which worries you a little.

steps.speaker: Guest A
steps.content: Did you see that family? Still the same, always turning the other cheek, except for when it comes to their reputation, that's when they get all worked up.

steps.speaker: Guest B
steps.content: That's how immigrants are. Their business relies entirely on their good reputation and connections. Say if there really was a Sinner in the family, who would dare be near them?

steps.speaker: Guest A
steps.content: True, but I just feel sorry for their poor children. They have to learn these trite rules from such a young age. Serve the family, never make a misstep, and all that...
The things you overhear as you weave through the crowd complete and confirm your suspicions about Shrooma's family.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: For such a family... a child who brings no benefit and might potentially tarnish their reputation will never be accepted, or worse, she might be abandoned immediately.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: This explains why Shrooma refuses to be bailed out and doesn't trust her family. As intelligent as she is, she must have foreseen this outcome.
However... you still feel something is off. After meeting her family, you now understand her secrecy, the mask she puts on, and her firm refusal, yet her actions remain contradictory.
The doubts in your heart have not vanished and are even intensifying with the quickening pulse from the shackles!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: It still doesn't make sense... Judging from Shrooma's attitude, she should want to break free from her family's restraints.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: But if that's the case, she should seize the opportunity to get bailed out, let her family reject her as a Sinner, and then escape. She shouldn't be trying to hide the truth. Unless...
Your steps slow down as the complex thoughts in your mind begin to unravel, revealing a conclusion you'd never considered before.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Unless... what she fears isn't the consequences, but the very fact that her Sinner identity is exposed to her family?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: But why?

No matter the reason, this is clearly something you can't deduce with the information you currently have. You stop thinking and come to your senses, only to find yourself standing in front of an unfamiliar passage.

steps.speaker: Joshua
steps.content: Look at you, you can't even handle the summer camp, yet you dare to take the spotlight at the banquet? You're going to embarrass the family again!

steps.speaker: Shrooma
steps.content: You're right, Joshua. I think it should be your turn too. But since the decision is already made, you shouldn't worry about it anymore.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: ...It's Shrooma and her cousin?

steps.speaker: Joshua
steps.content: What do I have to worry about?! You better make a fool of yourself onstage. That way, Grandpa will see who can truly shoulder the family's future!

steps.speaker: Shrooma
steps.content: I'm glad you're this ambitious. I'll be sure to convey that to Grandpa.
In contrast to her cousin's sharp, indignant tone, Shrooma's voice is calm and graceful, seemingly unwilling to argue with Joshua.
But despite her wish, her placatory attitude further enrages the boy, provoking him to scream almost hysterically.

steps.speaker: Joshua
steps.content: Quit acting like a goody-goody! You may be able to fool the outsiders, but do you think I don't know?!

steps.speaker: Joshua
steps.content: You really think you can hide it your whole life? Don't think any of your achievements will make everyone forget that thing about you and your monster mother!!

steps.speaker: Joshua
steps.content: Grandpa won't believe you, and neither will I. We're all watching you! You who did that to your sister even in the womb...

steps.speaker: Shrooma
steps.content: Joshua!!!
The word almost sounds spat out from a bottomless swamp, each syllable soaked with suppressed anger. Startled, the boy takes a few steps back.
You're instinctively aware that the interrupted sentence likely contains the secret Shrooma desperately wants to hide. But the tension doesn't allow you to listen in further.

Emotion is the explicit indicator of a Sinner's destructive power. And across the shackles, the negative emotions Shrooma has been accumulating since entering the venue are skyrocketing and about to explode.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Shrooma! How did you end up here?!
Right before Shrooma loses control, you shout her name and stride into the passage, verbally cautioning her while separating the two of them with your body.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Are you guys arguing about something? Joshua, would you calm down too? Anyway we are at the banquet.
Clearly not expecting you to hear his not-so-perfect words, the boy flees the scene in panic.

Only then do you turn around to look at Shrooma, who keeps her head down. Her fists are clenched, and her expression is hidden in the shadows, so you can only check her condition through the shackles.
Irritation, anger, fear... Her emotions still bubble like a boiling swamp, and you can only muster all your energy to suppress her nearly overflowing power.
Yet a few small mushrooms still sprout on the velvet-covered walls, their colors bright and vibrant, boldly displaying their poisonous nature.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Are you okay? Thankfully it's not too late. If someone found out...
The girl suddenly raises her head, interrupting you with a taunting smile. She seems to know you've overheard her secret and has given up pretending.

steps.speaker: Shrooma
steps.content: If someone found out? About what?

steps.speaker: Shrooma
steps.content: That I'm a loser who hates my so-called family? That I'm a Sinner, a monster?

steps.speaker: Shrooma
steps.content: A maggot in the gutter, a poisonous mushroom, a disgusting thing that must be hidden? Something that deserves to be ignored, chopped up, and thrown in the trash?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You know I would never think that.

steps.speaker: Shrooma
steps.content: Huh? Are you going to pretend you don't dislike me? Haven't you seen those posts? You should know full well what kind of person I am.

steps.speaker: Shrooma
steps.content: I know what they've written about me in those psychological assessments. You don't need to pretend that you understand me!

steps.speaker: Shrooma
steps.content: That's right, I'm a pathetic person. I typed every single one of those toxic words in those posts!

steps.speaker: Shrooma
steps.content: Those are all my true thoughts. Because yes, I hate everything!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Shrooma, listen to me. I will never despise or shun you because of the rants you posted on the dark web.
You try to calm her, but the explosive emotions have completely taken over the girl. The restless Mania is swirling around her, as if she exists in a vacuum filled only with malice.

steps.speaker: Shrooma
steps.content: It's true. I have a lot of malicious thoughts I need to get out of me! So what? Why can't I say them openly?

steps.speaker: Shrooma
steps.content: Why do you all despise malicious thoughts? As if you don't also get them? But everyone does, right?!
You shake your head, knowing it won't change anything even if you shout into her ear now.
So you give up on verbal communication and use the shackles to suppress her power, dragging her out of the banquet hall toward the empty courtyard.

steps.speaker: Shrooma
steps.content: W-what are you doing!!!
Shrooma lowers her voice in resistance. You drag her all the way to a big tree.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: This will do.

steps.speaker: Shrooma
steps.content: Wh-what?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: See this hollow in the tree? Shout into it. Say everything you've always wanted to say. Get it all out of your system.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Don't worry, I'll keep watch for you. No one will come.
Shrooma seems hesitant, but once she sees that you're serious, she pokes her head into the tree hollow gingerly and yells into it.

steps.speaker: Shrooma
steps.content: Joshua, you damn idiot! You brainless, stupid weirdo!!!
After that, she quickly pulls her head out and glances back at you. You command all your facial muscles to give her an encouraging smile.
This time, she seems to understand your intention. Her face looks enlivened and she turns back into the tree hollow, screaming again.

steps.speaker: Shrooma
steps.content: Go to hell, you *********!
After a while, Shrooma stops, panting heavily. Her face is flushed, but her eyes seem especially bright.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: How does that feel? Better? Still want to let Mania take over you now?
Shrooma looks at you as if seeing you for the first time, scrutinizing you up and down.

steps.speaker: Shrooma
steps.content: Am... Am I... cursing too much?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: The word choice is a little over the top, but emotionally, I understand it completely.
Seeming surprised at your response, Shrooma asks dazedly.

steps.speaker: Shrooma
steps.content: You're saying it's normal that I hold such malicious thoughts toward others?

steps.speaker: Shrooma
steps.content: It's okay to not hold back, and to vent it out like this? Am I not a piece of toxic trash?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: First, let's get this right. What you were just venting, and those things you posted online, they are not malicious thoughts, just negative emotions.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Everyone gets these emotions, but if you don't handle them properly and promptly, they can fester into something more toxic. That's when it becomes real malice.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: For instance, you almost got corrupted by Mania just now because you didn't handle them properly, which could have caused much greater harm than making posts online.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Of course, you may still harm others if you don't control the way you vent your emotions. That's where the Bureau comes in.

steps.speaker: Shrooma
steps.content: Do you also get such emotions and thoughts, Chief?

steps.speaker: Shrooma
steps.content: Do you also scream into tree holes like this?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: ...Ahem, I'd appreciate some privacy.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: In short, I don't think having negative emotions makes you a piece of toxic trash, or anything like that.
Shrooma looks stunned, as if hearing this kind of words for the first time. Her effort to digest your saying looks cute but so heart-wrenching.
But just as you can't resist walking over to pat her head, she steps back.

steps.speaker: Shrooma
steps.content: ...Hmph, don't act like you know me so well. Wait until you find out about everything before playing the savior.

steps.speaker: Shrooma
steps.content: By then, you may despise me and regret having said all this today.
She turns around and runs toward the banquet hall. You consider running after her, but give up after some thought.
You turn your head and see the hem of a delicate and luxurious dress peeking out from the shadows.
